For medical-type adhesive strips, such as wound-closure strips, the patient can remove them: let them loosen and fall off on their own, usually within about 7 to 10 days, and if one is still attached after that, ease it off gently along the skin. My earlier answer assumed household hanging strips like Command strips, so its hairdryer and floss steps don't apply here. I'm not certain which kind of strip you mean, so this could change.

CONFIDENCE: 55
